title: PerformanceHistory — ring buffer time series for timeline visualization
description:
Implement Source/Analysis/PerformanceHistory as the fixed-memory ring buffer backing the Performance Timeline visualization (spec §20.1).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §20.1 Performance Timeline lanes (key envelope, main envelope, open/close thresholds, noise floor, transient events, sustain confidence, gate state lane, output gain, lookahead region, alignment offset, attenuation shading)
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §28.2 analysis transport and QualityMode (Off/Live/Studio/Diagnose)
- Source/Analysis/AnalysisFifo.h AnalysisFrame fields and QualityMode from h.1

Implement PerformanceHistory.h/.cpp:
- Ring buffer of timeline samples/slots (fixed capacity from prepare). History duration configurable in [2, 30] seconds; sample/slot rate is control-rate or decimated audio (e.g. one slot per AnalysisFrame push or fixed Hz); document chosen rate.
- Per-slot series at minimum: keyEnvelope, mainEnvelope, thresholdOpen, thresholdClose, noiseFloor, gateState, outputGain, transientMarker, sustainConfidence. Optional: alignmentOffset, lookaheadRegion flag if present on AnalysisFrame.
- External API for GUI/message thread: pushFromFrame(const AnalysisFrame&) or push(...scalars...); getDurationSeconds / setDurationSeconds(2..30) that retire capacity or mark valid window without audio-thread realloc; getNumSamples / copyRecent(...) into caller buffers for painting.
- All writes/reads use only preallocated storage. When QualityMode is Off, ignore pushes. Live may retain shorter effective window or higher decimation than Studio/Diagnose if helpful — document.
- prepare(sampleRateOrControlRate, maxDurationSeconds=30, numChannels as needed) / reset().
- Runs exclusively on background/message thread consumers or accepts already-dequeued frames from AnalysisFifo (do not touch AbstractFifo internals beyond using public AnalysisFrame).

Do NOT implement NoiseFingerprint, AlignmentScopeData, integrity analyzers, PluginProcessor, CMakeLists, or tests.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: PerformanceHistory stores ring-buffer series for envelopes, thresholds, noise floor, gate state, gain, transients, and sustain confidence
History duration is configurable in the range 2–30 seconds with fixed memory sized in prepare
copyRecent or equivalent read API exposes contiguous or two-segment ring data for GUI painting without allocating
No heap allocation on the hot push path after prepare
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: allocate beyond prepare/setDuration’s controlled reallocation path on the audio thread

allowed: decimate AnalysisFrame stream to a fixed control-rate history Hz
store gateState as uint8_t/int matching state-machine encoding
resize ring only from message thread when duration changes, with double-buffer or exchange if needed
include optional alignment/lookahead series when AnalysisFrame provides them
forbidden: implement attack/tail integrity scoring inside PerformanceHistory
perform FFT or heavy spectral work in this class
